rationale: Derived from paired-20261104-122527-75371a04-v032 and paired-20261104-123109-5f5905f7-v032-2 telemetry reviews: (1) In v032, cruising spark oscillation was 100% eliminated (0 torque control spark cuts vs. 881 in v031), confirming anti-shuffle neutralization. (2) Decel pops were reported quiet because [ECM] 44605 3,000 RPM cell at -3.00 deg was too shallow and 2,000 RPM at +8.00 deg pulled timing positive too early (below 2,727 RPM) during coast-down. (3) Candidate v033 deepens [ECM] 44605: 3,000 RPM retarded to -8.00 deg ATDC, 4,000-6,000 RPM deepened to -10.00 deg ATDC for sharp, explosive overrun pops, and 2,000 RPM lowered to +2.00 deg for smooth non-bogging return to idle. (4) Extends [ECM] 44496 DFCO delay from 1.35s to 1.40s (+50ms) to widen overrun fuel availability. Preserves v032 anti-shuffle fix and v031 MAF trim.
